name: page-lab
description: Author Violentmonkey userscripts and diagnose live pages from one place — a measure-before-you-select method, a two-way element picker driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, a config-driven redesign acceptance runner that injects at document-start across real navigations and exercises the result with trusted events, performance/network/console diagnosis, and a Greasy Fork readiness linter, and a multi-agent method for redesigning a whole site, a supervised-driving lock that keeps the operator out of their own Chromium while the agent drives it, until the agent finishes or the operator presses Esc, and a dedicated headless browser profile with a challenge-stop gate, headed handoff and resume for unattended runs.
